english.title: Business owner when botulinum toxin or filler for cosmetic purpose administered to person under 18 by unapproved person
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were a business owner when, in the course of your business, a person other than an approved person administered in England

(A)_[botulinum toxin]_
(B)_[a subcutaneous, submucous or intradermal injection of a filler for a cosmetic purpose]_

to **(..SPECIFY PERSON TO WHOM TOXIN OR INJECTION ADMINISTERED..), a person under the age of 18
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2(1)(a) and (3) of the Botulinum Toxin and Cosmetic Fillers (Children) Act 2021.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) Note the defences in section 2(4) of the Botulinum Toxin and Cosmetic Fillers (Children) Act 2021.
(ii) A local weights and measures authority may enforce in its area the provisions of this offence.
